steps.input:
p=pathlib.Path(base+'/programs/task-3615c30d.py')
code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]
    R=len(g); C=len(g[0])
    # Horizontal bars with a single internal zero gap define vertical color bands.
    bars=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(grid):
        nz=[(j,v) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v]
        if len(nz)>=3 and len({v for j,v in nz})==1:
            color=nz[0][1]
            gaps=[j for j in range(nz[0][0],nz[-1][0]+1) if row[j]==0]
            if gaps: bars.append((i,color,gaps))
    for col in sorted({c for _,_,gs in bars for c in gs}):
        relevant=[(i,color) for i,color,gs in bars if col in gs]
        prev=0
        for i,color in relevant:
            for r in range(prev,i+1):
                if g[r][col]==0: g[r][col]=color
            prev=i+1
    return g
'''
p.write_text(code)
